name: Free Republic
desc:
Each shot with the Liberator grants +5% to your next headshot damage with the Centurion. Max is 200%
Kills with the Centurion grants +10% RPM to all weapons for 10 seconds

name: The Devil's Heel
desc:
Both weapons gain the Fire and Fury talents and the buff durations are increased by 15 seconds.
Bonuses from Fire and Fury are no longer lost when swapping between Fire and Fury.
Weapon swap speed is increased by 50%.

name: Twin Valkyries
desc:
Each hit with Hildr increases critical hit damage by 1% to a max of 30%. The bonus decreases by 1% every second.
This bonus applies only to Eir.
